what: dcp.async_save on the training process group (no process_group argument), 4 ranks, gloo, native macOS, torch 2.14.1, d 64 model, checkpoint at step 3
run1: hung: all four ranks at 0% CPU after the first async checkpoint, no output for over 4 minutes (process group timeout 120 s did not fire); killed by hand

run2.symptom: two ranks aborted (SIGABRT, exit -6) about 3 s after the checkpoint at step 3
run2.error: gloo::EnforceNotMet: [enforce fail at <pytorch build tree>/third_party/gloo/gloo/transport/uv/pair.cc:253] op.nread == op.preamble.nbytes

fix: dist.new_group(backend="gloo") once, passed as async_save(..., process_group=ck_pg): 60-step runs complete (train_async.jsonl)
source_advice: PyTorch blog 2024-11 'Reducing Model Checkpointing Times by Over 10x with PyTorch Distributed Asynchronous Checkpointing': initialize a separate process group for async checkpointing to avoid a collective hang
